title: [Client Gig] @SamanthaAnderl: "Freelance work doesn't have to mean feast or famine. Check this d..."
body:
Freelance work doesn't have to mean feast or famine. Check this daily and it won't.

The @MeetHarlow Freelance Job Board features fresh gigs across a variety of industries and verticals, so you can keep your project pipeline full.

Here are 5 that caught our attention this week.

QwikFix is looking for a Freelance Copywriter with email and SMS experience to revise 47 emails and 27 text messages using an existing audit and rewrite framework. Real estate or home services experience is preferred, and the project is expected to be completed within one month. Pays $2,000–$5,000 depending on experience.

https://t.co/lbWCwv5D2S

Amentum is seeking a Technical Writer to support their WTP/WTCC Project. You’ll prepare written material for publication, including reports, manuals, briefs, proposals, instruction books, catalogs, and related technical and administrative publications. Pays roughly $90/hour.

https://t.co/zVWfmwWzcM

Humble Futures Funding is looking for a Paid Social & Affiliate Growth Manager to lead a structured 30-day test with the goal of a longer-term role. You'll own their paid social strategy and affiliate partner program, working with their existing content creator. Pays $1000.

https://t.co/XOI9WysPKE

Zero Heroes is looking for a Jewelry Designer to help create innovative designs, develop products, and bring creative concepts to life. You’ll work on fashion design, accessories, and product development to align with their brand’s gothic and grunge aesthetics. Get pitching.

https://t.co/QGC5rEDRfg

Unrivaled Basketball is seeking a Seasonal Social Media Publishing Coordinator to provide support across all of their platforms during the 2026–2027 season. Expected to begin on December 26, 2026 and continue through approximately mid-March 2027. Pitch your rate.

https://t.co/yRCdjfLeps

Want to apply to more roles like these?

Check out the Harlow Freelance Job Board.

https://t.co/1WuE6qHm71

—
Harlow is a home for freelancers. Harlow helps freelancers, founders, and small business owners build businesses that light them up and fill their bank accounts.
